inputs.text: Ahead of the 2027 elections, the priority should be responsible leadership, party unity and candidates who answer to voters—not class-war slogans that treat wealth as proof of wrongdoing. Disagreements within the APC should be handled through accountable institutions, not used to discredit the system itself. Broad participation matters when it reinforces order and responsibility, not when it becomes a pretext for weakening them.
